message: You know I like the fancy talk, Mose, and I meant that "purchase" to invoke and point to the fine line from *Raising Arizona*, among [other](http://www.slimcoincidence.com/blog/2005/03/they_have_a_word_for_it.php) things. And again, thanks to all for the kind words. Doc -- love the photo, but I'm afraid you might have to settle for some good unoaked Chardonnay, but I do like the Nobilio and that nice New Zealand zing.
